turns.q: Is a damaged item handled differently from a normal return?
turns.replyTail:
Yes. A damaged item is handled as a product issue, not as a normal change-of-mind return. Please send clear photos or a video showing the damage, along with your order number, purchase email, and phone number. Report it within 5 calendar days of delivery, and note the damage on the delivery receipt if possible.

The usual return windows, such as the 100-night trial for mattresses, do not replace this damage-reporting process.

turns.q: Do you need photos, and where do I send them?
turns.replyTail: Yes, please send clear photos, or a video, showing the damage. Submit them through the contact form on tediber.com, with your order number, the email address used for the purchase, and your phone number. Please report the damage within 5 calendar days of delivery.

turns.q: Will I get a replacement or a refund?
turns.replyTail: A replacement or refund is not automatic. The damage must first be reviewed from the photos or video and your order details, then the appropriate solution will be confirmed. Please send those details through the contact form on tediber.com, within 5 calendar days of delivery.

turns.q: Do I have to pay anything to return the damaged item?
turns.replyTail: No normal change-of-mind return fee should be applied to a damaged item. If the damage is confirmed and the return is approved, Tediber covers or reimburses reasonable return shipping costs, depending on the case. Please send the photos and order details first, and wait for the return instructions before paying for shipment yourself.

turns.q: How long does the replacement take?
turns.replyTail: There is no fixed replacement timeframe I can confirm before the damage is reviewed. Please submit the photos or video and your order details first. Once the solution is approved, the delivery timing will depend on the product and delivery option available for your order.

turns.q: What if more than one item in my order is affected?
turns.replyTail: Please list every affected item in the same report and include clear photos or a video showing the damage to each one. Add your order number, purchase email, and phone number, then submit everything through the contact form on tediber.com within 5 calendar days of delivery. Each item will be reviewed as part of the same order claim.

turns.q: Can I keep the damaged item or must I ship it back?
turns.replyTail:
Please keep the damaged item for now and do not ship it back on your own. The return arrangement depends on the solution approved after reviewing the damage and your order. If a return is required, you will receive the specific instructions, such as a return label or collection arrangements.

Please include photos or a video of the damage when you submit your report.
